truth.why: The G.12 closure runs from 23 November to 4 December, between the series' remaining dates of 12 November and 10 December, so neither seminar is affected and D1 (all three talks in G.12) stands. The booking for Thursday 12 November goes in for G.12 as planned, with catering, recording and the guest room unchanged.
